name: Hamlet
message: To be or not to be...

name: Hamlet
message: Whether it's nobler to try and suffer through the pain...

name: Hamlet
message: Or turn our backs to all of it and welcome the inevitable embrace of death a little earlier.

name: Hamlet
message: To die—to sleep no more—And by sleeping, I mean to end the heartache, the thousand little pains I have to bear.

name: Hamlet
message: I wish I could. Just die—sleep, sleep, and maybe dream... that would be it. Who knows what I might dream of in death?

name: Hamlet
message: Honest as always, and ever so naïve! I loved you once for those very qualities.

name: Hamlet
message: You were a fool if you truly believed me. Ophelia, I never loved you.

name: Ophelia
message: (I don't believe that. I don't even think he believes that. But he's in a fit.)
